name: application-checkboxes
title: Checkboxes
description: Styled checkbox inputs for selecting one or more options in forms, settings panels, and filter lists.
useWhen: Users can select zero or more independent options from a list.
Building filter panels where multiple categories can be active simultaneously.
Presenting a list of settings that each have a binary on/off state.
avoidWhen: Only one option can be selected at a time — use radio buttons instead.
The toggle represents an immediate system state change — use a toggle switch instead.
There are more than ten options — consider a multi-select dropdown to save space.
responsiveBehavior: Checkboxes remain their natural size; surrounding layout reflows at small viewports. Ensure the tap target area extends beyond the checkbox element itself.
accessibility: Each checkbox must have an associated <label> element linked via for/id or wrapping.
Group related checkboxes in a <fieldset> with a <legend> that names the group.
Do not rely on color alone to indicate the checked state — the browser-native checkmark provides the signal.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Simple labelled checkbox list for selecting multiple independent options in a settings or filter context.
accessibility: Each checkbox requires a linked <label>; group the list in a <fieldset> with a <legend>.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Simple labelled checkbox list adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark label text and checkbox border colors must meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.

variants.title: Described
variants.description: Checkbox list where each option includes a label and a supporting description line for additional context.
accessibility: Description text should be associated with the checkbox via aria-describedby.

variants.title: Described (Dark)
variants.description: Checkbox list with per-option description lines adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Description text color must maintain sufficient contrast against dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Described with divide
variants.description: Described checkbox list with horizontal dividers between options to improve scannability in longer lists.
accessibility: Dividers are decorative and must not interrupt the logical reading order of the list.

variants.title: Described with divide (Dark)
variants.description: Divider-separated described checkbox list adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark divider colors must provide sufficient visual separation without obscuring focus indicators.
